title: Find the marsh dawn take
brief: My field recordings pile up as cryptic filenames, so I can never find the marsh dawn take I know I have.

target_population.role: hobbyist sound recordist archiving dawn-chorus field sessions
target_population.coverage_limit: one personal archive of metadata records; no audio files, playback, or uploads

core_task.summary: tag a recording with habitat and time of day, then find it by filter
core_task.success_oracle: tagging take FR-021 with marsh and dawn, then filtering the catalog to marsh, lists FR-021 among exactly three results

not_applicable_states.loading: the archive is seeded metadata held locally and filters recompute in memory, so the shelf never shows a fetching or buffering frame

state_recipes.empty: filter to the glacier habitat, which holds no seeded takes; the shelf offers to clear the filter instead of standing blank
state_recipes.validation-error: apply a custom tag with an empty name; an inline error refuses the tag and the take is unchanged
state_recipes.success: tag FR-021 marsh and dawn, then filter marsh; three takes line the shelf including FR-021
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the habitat filter shows its visible focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the catalog at 390x844; the filter shelf folds into a chip row above the list

acceptance_facts: The seed catalogs eighteen recordings across five habitats with duration and recording gear noted for each take.
After tagging FR-021 with marsh and dawn, the marsh filter returns exactly three takes.
Filtering to a habitat with no takes offers to clear the filter instead of showing a blank shelf.

product_signature.mechanism: tag-shelf browser that files takes by habitat and hour instead of filename
product_signature.anchor: filter shelf across the top of the catalog
product_signature.brief_trace: can never find the marsh dawn take I know I have
product_signature.counterfactual: a file-manager table would fit a downloads-folder brief and leaves the filenames just as cryptic
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows the marsh shelf holding three takes with FR-021 among them

anti_goals: no audio playback, waveforms, or file uploads; this is a metadata catalog
no GPS, maps, or location pins; habitats are named tags
no sharing, publishing, or community features

content_seed.data_notes: eighteen invented takes; two marsh takes are pre-tagged so FR-021 becomes the third marsh result, and glacier is absent to fix the empty state
